bibl.title: Verrius Flaccus, his Alexandrian Model, or Just an Anonymous Grammarian? The Most Ancient Direct Witness of a Latin Ars Grammatica.
bibl.seg: Maria Chiara Scappaticcio, Verrius Flaccus, his Alexandrian Model, or Just an Anonymous Grammarian? The Most Ancient Direct Witness of a Latin Ars Grammatica.
bibl.note: P. Lond. Inv. 2723 (= P. lit. Lond. 184) + P. Mich. Inv. 4649 verso = P. Mich. VII, 429 (= MP3 2996; LDAB 5065). - Pars prima. An Alexandrian-oriented Ars 1. Parts of speech; - 2. Elements of speech; - 3. Vitia et virtutes. - Pars secunda. Ars grammatica or De Orthographia?: 1. Readerships: second-century Egypt; - 2. Before Remmius Palaemon.
